title.narrative: Improving investment in ocean science through the Ocean Decade

description.narrative: The 2024 Ocean Decade Conference held in April 2024 was a milestone moment in the implementation of the Ocean Decade. Over 2,600 participants from 124 countries gathered in Barcelona, Spain over 3 days to discuss future priorities for the Ocean Decade. The outcomes of the Conference are captured in The Barcelona Statement which is structured in two parts: (i) science and knowledge priorities, and (ii) cross-cutting and enabling conditions has been translated into several languages and has already been widely disseminated in international and regional conferences and events. The priorities contained in The Barcelona Statement will be used to inform discussions at the 2025 United Nations Ocean Conference to be held in Nice, France in June 2025, and the pre-Conference special events focusing on science, coastal resilience and blue economy. Issues related to financing and investment in ocean science and ocean science infrastructure, the role of philanthropy to support the Ocean Decade, and the need for increased support to Decade Actions to improve skills in strategic communication and fundraising were important priorities discussed at the 2024 Ocean Decade Conference. The project will advance coordination across these three issues and provide support to future triennial events in the Ocean Decade Conference series that will build on the achievements and outcomes of the 2024 event.
